title: [SEP-2] The access-key chain links every epoch of a channel at the relay, but the spec says rotati
description: Review finding SEP-2: The access-key chain links every epoch of a channel at the relay, but the spec says rotation prevents this (lens SEP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:185 (`"epoch": 17` in clear), 203, 216; spec/10-relays.md:504, 518; spec/12-security.md:34, 46; spec/11-transport.md:335. Fix: As proposed. 05:203 says "The relay thereby follows the chain from token to token", while 10:518 says a relay "cannot correlate them without also capturing the epoch secrets" and 12:34 says it cannot "Map routing tables across epochs". 05:216 says the wrapper hides `epoch`, but the RoutingEnvelope carries `epoch` in clear. The chain is fixed by Q1/Q6, so the text must change. Also note in §12.4 that gossip peers can follow the chain, because announcements ride in clear on the routing envelope. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
